semantics.aliases: OrdinalIgnoreCase for these ASCII aliases. Quoted '!true' is scalar data; !!true is two syntax nodes; a property value '!!true' is not reparsed and cannot be converted as an alias. Quoted or expanded whitespace is not trimmed.
semantics.empty: Empty Condition attribute remains true. Empty/undefined scalar alone is non-Boolean, not false. Equality checks both operands' emptiness before attempting Boolean operators; preserve source order and avoid eagerly evaluating every node.
semantics.typeFlow: Operator nodes supply Boolean, no numeric value and generally no string. Not additionally returns ! plus child expanded text for fallback. Grouping returns the same node, not an implicitly Boolean wrapper. Compare strings only after both preceding conversion attempts fail; never stringify a Boolean operator to true/false to make an otherwise invalid comparison succeed.
semantics.errors: Malformed grammar is parse-time. Reached non-Boolean root uses native ConditionNotBooleanDetail; Not/And/Or child conversion uses ExpressionDoesNotEvaluateToBoolean; absent relation string representation can use IllFormedCondition. Record native codes/locations/messages from capture, then map private errors honestly. Source resource names are not invented observed codes.
semantics.laziness: And/Or short-circuit reached evaluation, property expansion, predicate conversion/probes and Boolean failures. Syntax is still parsed on both sides and statically across the private XML validation boundary. Equality's empty optimization may skip evaluation of an operator even though both syntax operands exist.
semantics.cache: Exact raw ordinal text and current AllowProperties profile; cache immutable syntax only. Separate each evaluation's expanded values/conversion state. Never key by expanded result, owner, globals or normalized spacing. Warning emitted at first reached parse, with actual source owner/line/column/raw text; static validation does not warm cache. Retain >3000 clear behavior without claiming native eviction/concurrency parity.
semantics.itemBoundary: Boolean scalar 'true;false' is one non-Boolean string, not two items. HasTrailingSlash retains split-before-unescape/trim/cardinality conversion. Raw @(...), %(...), property functions and ItemGroup remain refused under inherited static profile; do not advertise them as supported skipped operations.
